data.long_description:
Provident Real Estate is pleased to present this well-appointed 2-bedroom apartment in Qamar 8, Madinat Badr — a perfect choice for both end users and investors seeking space, comfort, and long-term value.


  This thoughtfully designed residence offers a generous layout complemented by modern finishes, creating a bright and welcoming living environment. With a private balcony overlooking the podium and well-planned interiors, this home delivers both functionality and style.


  Property Features:
  • 2 Spacious Bedrooms
  • 3 Modern Bathrooms
  • Maid’s Room
  • Private Balcony with Podium View
  • Dedicated Storage Space
  • Secure Lobby with 24/7 Security


  Community & Nearby Highlights:
  • Close to International School of Arts & Sciences
  • Nearby Cafés and Dining Options
  • Easy access to Dubai International Airport
  • Family-friendly community with landscaped surroundings


  Located within the vibrant community of Madinat Badr, Qamar 8 offers residents a balanced lifestyle with excellent connectivity, peaceful surroundings, and access to everyday conveniences.


  Offered at: AED 2,200,000


  A fantastic opportunity to secure a spacious home or a high-potential investment in one of Dubai’s growing residential communities.


  Contact Provident Real Estate today to arrange a viewing.
